When an online session is a good fit

First assessment

Talk through your pain or injury and get advice on what to do next.

Exercise correction

Your physiotherapist watches you do your exercises and corrects your form in real time.

Posture and ergonomics

Set up your desk and work habits to reduce neck and back pain from long hours at a screen.

Follow-ups

Keep your recovery on track between home visits or after you finish a course of treatment.

Sessions run on Google Meet. You join with one tap from your booking, and afterwards you receive a digital prescription with your exercises.

How booking works

  1. Choose your care mode: a home visit at your doorstep or an online video session.
  2. Pick your city and area to see physiotherapists who serve your locality.
  3. Compare therapists: photo, qualifications, specialities, years of practice, patient reviews and the consultation fee, shown before you book.
  4. Choose a single session or a package of 5, 10 or 15 days, every day or on alternate days.
  5. Pay securely with UPI, card or net banking and get an instant confirmation.

Frequently asked questions

Does online physiotherapy really work?

For many conditions, yes. Online sessions are well suited to assessments, exercise programmes, posture and ergonomic advice, and follow-ups between home visits. Your physiotherapist will tell you if a condition needs hands-on treatment.

What do I need for an online session?

A phone or laptop with a camera, a stable internet connection and enough space to move. The session runs on Google Meet and you join with one tap from your booking.

Can I book an online session from outside Gujarat?

Yes. Online video sessions are not limited to one city, so you can consult a PhysioConnect physiotherapist from anywhere in India.

Will I get an exercise plan?

Yes. After the session your physiotherapist shares a digital prescription with your exercises, sets, repetitions and precautions.
